data.name: Hotel Rio Malecon
data.description:
A block from the beach, this laid-back hotel off Highway 200 is 1.3 km from the sands of Playa de los Muertos and 13 km from the animals at Zoologico de Vallarta.
Featuring balconies, tiled floors and neutral decor, the bright, modern rooms come with complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and safes; some have kitchenettes. Room service is available. A child under 10 stays free with an adult.
International cuisine is served in a relaxed, poolside bar/restaurant. Other amenities include a chlorine-free outdoor pool and event space.
